# Data Lakehouse & Streaming: Kafka, Flink, Spark, Doris, Superset, Airflow & Digital Twin (`data-kafka-flink-doris-superset-airflow`)

> **Group:** III. Enterprise, Data Lake & AI Systems
> **Product Archetypes:** Data_AI_Pipeline, Telemetry_Streaming_Platform
> **Trigger Signals:** kafka, flink, spark, doris, superset, airflow, digital-twin, clickhouse, elasticsearch, apm, redis, mongodb, cassandra

## [ BLOCK: kafka-and-stream-processor-exposure ]
### Kafka Brokers/Proxies, Flink/Spark Job Submission & Digital Twin State
- Check whether Kafka proxies (`coms-kafka`), Schema Registries, Flink/Spark REST APIs, or Airflow webservers are reachable without SASL/mTLS or role authentication.
- Trace whether poisoned telemetry events on Kafka topics can corrupt Digital Twin vehicle/device state or trigger downstream automated actions.

## [ BLOCK: superset-doris-and-analytics-ssrf-sqli ]
### Apache Superset, Doris OLAP & BI Dashboard SSRF / SQL Injection
- Audit analytics queries and BI connectors for raw SQL interpolation, metadata SSRF, and missing row-level security (RLS) across regions/subsidiaries.

## [ BLOCK: general-injection-sqli-nosqli-and-log-poisoning ]
### OLAP SQL/NoSQL Injection, Airflow DAG Code Injection & Log/Telemetry Poisoning
- Audit Doris, ClickHouse, Superset, Elasticsearch, and MongoDB query builders for raw string formatting (`f"SELECT ... {param}"`), SQL injection, and NoSQL operator injection.
- Check Airflow DAGs and Spark/Flink jobs for unsafe `eval`/`exec` or shell command injection via `dag_run.conf` parameters.
- Verify schema validation and log sanitization (ASVS V16) to prevent poisoned Kafka events from corrupting analytics or SIEM audit pipelines.

### Standard Mappings
- OWASP-API8:2023, ASVS-V5, ASVS-V16, CWE-89, CWE-94, CWE-117, CWE-502

### Safe Patterns (Refutation Anchors)
- SASL/SCRAM or mTLS authentication with topic-level ACLs on Kafka brokers, Schema Registry, and Flink/Airflow APIs
- Parameterized SQL queries / bound parameters on Doris, ClickHouse, and Postgres analytics endpoints with tenant row-level filtering
- Strict Avro/Protobuf schema validation and bounds checking on Kafka consumers before updating Digital Twin state

### Vulnerable Patterns
- Raw f-string or string concatenation in Doris/ClickHouse/SQL queries or Airflow BashOperator commands using untrusted input
- Unauthenticated Kafka REST proxy, Flink job submission API, or Airflow webserver reachable on internal or public networks
- Kafka consumer deserializing untrusted Pickle/Java objects or applying unvalidated telemetry directly to actuation topics

### Mandatory Evidence (`required_evidence`)
- ev_... excerpt of Kafka/Flink/Airflow consumer or DAG code showing input parsing and query/command construction
- ev_... excerpt of broker/database client configuration showing SASL/mTLS and ACL settings

### Verification Questions When Static Code Is Inconclusive (`questions_when_unclear`)
- Are Kafka topic ACLs enforced at the MSK / EMQX / Confluent broker layer restricting which producers can publish to this topic?
- Does Apache Superset / Doris enforce row-level security (RLS) policies per user role in the database metadata?
